newsitem.title: CHINA: China nabs 62,000 T of smuggled oil products.
newsitem.headline: China nabs 62,000 T of smuggled oil products.

text.p: China's customs officials seized 62,000 tonnes of smuggled oil products in 41 cases from January to June, the People's Daily said on Tuesday.
It estimated the value of the smuggled oil products at 133 million yuan.

Most of the smuggled oil products had been confiscated during a crackdown between late May and the end of June by customs officials in the southern provinces of Guangdong, Guangxi and Zhejiang, the newspaper said.
Officials have reported an influx of smuggled diesel fuel in recent months and the People's Daily said the smuggling had risen sharply since international prices slumped in March.
